# What should you make this week?

> Free production mix optimizer for bakeries, workshops and small makers. Enter your products, margins and the hours or machines each one uses; it finds the most profitable weekly mix with whole batches and overtime, and shows what one more hour of your bottleneck is worth. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
